title: Parallel change jobs keep going stale after passing when a sibling lands governed content first; by design nothing retries them

brief.question: Should Athena retry a stale job by itself, merging its kept change onto the new tip and verifying again?
brief.if_yes: Passed work lands with nobody retrying it by hand; only the checks and verification run again.
brief.if_no: Stale jobs keep losing their spend until someone notices and retries them by hand.
brief.cost: One more check-and-verify run per stale job, under a dollar each (estimate); a change to the design doc.
brief.recommendation: Yes: seven jobs went stale in three days, and the cheap merge-and-verify retry already exists.
